Unity Special Folder Names: .tmp files are ignored by Unity; proof PNGs, docs, projectauditor outputs, py files, generated scene YAML, and transfer staging PNGs are not ignored just because they are non-runtime.

Unity Visual Studio Editor: Regenerate project files updates/creates .csproj files from External Tools settings.
Microsoft Visual Studio docs: .slnx is an XML solution file format option.
GitHub Unity .gitignore: root .csproj/.sln and InitTestScene*.unity* are generated ignore classes.
Project flora import log: family.kelp.tall was imported from Assets/TRANSFER HUB/family kelp tall into the routed _Project texture folder.
Reddit is anecdotal only and was not used as deletion authority.
